settings.name: all
settings.label: Show All Arcade Bullet and Melee Push Sections
settings.description: Opens or closes all NPC and vehicle bullet/melee push sections below.

settings.name: bullet
settings.label: Show NPC Bullet Push
settings.description: Shows or hides this section without changing any saved physics values.

settings.name: arcadeBulletsEnabled
settings.label: Enable NPC Bullet Push
settings.description: Master switch for Arcade bullet push on NPCs. This is independent from Vehicle Bullet Push.

settings.name: arcadeOnHitEnabled
settings.label: Arcade NPC Bullet Push - On Hit
settings.description: Allow Weapon Pushback & Arcade shove to trigger on hits (when weapon is allowed).

settings.name: arcadeOnDeathEnabled
settings.label: Arcade NPC Bullet Push - On Death
settings.description: Allow Weapon Pushback & Arcade behavior to run from death path when applicable.

settings.name: arcadeBulletStrength
settings.label: Strength
settings.description: Horizontal shove strength.

settings.name: arcadeBulletUp
settings.label: Up
settings.description: Vertical lift added to shove impulse.

settings.name: arcadeBulletDown
settings.label: Down
settings.description: Positive downward amount. Runtime subtracts this from Up; the menu never uses negative values.

settings.name: arcadePlayerOnly
settings.label: Arcade Player Only
settings.description: If ON: Arcade shove only triggers from player hits. NPC vs NPC will not shove.

settings.name: showArcadeAdvanced
settings.label: Show Advanced NPC Bullet Push
settings.description: Show extra arcade tuning sliders.

settings.name: showArcadeTargetFilters
settings.label: Show enemy type exclusions
settings.description: Show controls for special enemy types affected by Arcade/Bullet Jolts: MaxTac, bosses, mechs, robots, and drones. Hidden by default.

settings.name: showArcadeWeaponMuls
settings.label: Show NPC Bullet Weapon Multipliers
settings.description: Show the per-weapon force controls.

settings.name: melee
settings.label: Show NPC Melee Push
settings.description: Shows or hides this section without changing any saved physics values.

settings.name: arcadeMeleeEnabled
settings.label: Enable NPC Melee Push
settings.description: Allow blunt, blade, fists, and Gorilla-style melee attacks to use separate Arcade force controls.

settings.name: arcadeMeleeStrength
settings.label: Melee strength
settings.description: Horizontal Arcade force for melee hits.

settings.name: arcadeMeleeUp
settings.label: Melee Up
settings.description: Positive upward amount for Arcade melee.

settings.name: arcadeMeleeDown
settings.label: Melee Down
settings.description: Positive downward amount for Arcade melee; runtime subtracts it.

settings.name: enemyTypeFiltersEnabled
settings.label: Enable enemy type exclusions
settings.description: ON = use the special enemy type rules below. OFF = treat MaxTac, bosses, mechs, robots, and drones like normal NPCs.

settings.name: enemyBypassCanRagdollGate
settings.label: Allow special enemies to bypass CanRagdoll block
settings.description: ON = enabled special enemy types can still receive Arcade force when vanilla CanRagdoll would block them.

settings.name: enemyArcadeScaleMaxTac
settings.label: MaxTac Arcade force scale
settings.description: Multiplier for arcade force on MaxTac/drop-ship police. 1.0 = same as normal NPCs.

settings.name: enemyArcadeScaleBosses
settings.label: Boss Arcade force scale
settings.description: Boss arcade multiplier. Lower this if bosses should feel heavier.

settings.name: enemyArcadeScaleMechs
settings.label: Mech Arcade force scale
settings.description: Mech arcade multiplier. Default is lower so heavy machines do not fly like humans.

settings.name: enemyArcadeScaleRobots
settings.label: Robot/drone Arcade force scale
settings.description: Robot/drone arcade multiplier. Default is lower so machines feel heavier.

settings.name: arcadeBulletRadius
settings.label: Radius
settings.description: Impulse radius for ApplyImpulse.

settings.name: arcadeApplicationPointOffset
settings.label: Application point lower offset
settings.description: 0 = exact bullet hit point. 1 = move the impulse application point down toward the hips to reduce head-first dives.

settings.name: arcadeBulletCooldown
settings.label: Cooldown
settings.description: Anti volleyball cooldown per target.

settings.name: arcadeImpulseDelay
settings.label: Impulse delay (s)
settings.description: Delay before ApplyImpulse.

settings.name: arcadeCowScale
settings.label: Cower scale
settings.description: Cower strength scale.

settings.name: weaponchoice
settings.label: Use custom weapon allow-list
settings.description: OFF = Arcade applies to all recognized weapon groups. ON = only the enabled weapon groups below can trigger Arcade force.

settings.name: arcadeMeleeRadius
settings.label: Melee radius
settings.description: Impulse radius for Arcade melee.

settings.name: enemyArcadeAllowMaxTac
settings.label: Arcade can affect MaxTac
settings.description: ON = Arcade can affect MaxTac / 2nd-wave ship-drop police. OFF = excluded from Arcade force.

settings.name: vehicleBulletEnabled
settings.label: Bullets can move vehicles
settings.description: Gun hits can push vehicles using the weapon-group sliders below.

settings.name: vehicleOccupantShieldEnabled
settings.label: Experimental: protect drivers/passengers
settings.description: ON = vehicle hits still move the car, but SPLAT puppet impulses are blocked from mounted drivers/passengers so they do not fly through doors or snap back into seats.

settings.name: vehicleMountedHitImmunity
settings.label: Experimental: ignore direct mounted hits
settings.description: ON = while a driver/passenger is still owned by the vehicle seat or exit animation, SPLAT skips the NPC hit pipeline entirely. The car still receives vehicle impulses from windows/body hits. This prevents invisible-driver seat snap and bodies launching through doors.

settings.name: vehicleMulHandgun
settings.label: Vehicle Bullet Handgun multiplier
settings.description: Vehicle impulse multiplier for Handgun hits. This setting affects vehicles only, not NPC Arcade push.

settings.name: vehicleMulMagnum
settings.label: Vehicle Bullet Magnum multiplier
settings.description: Vehicle impulse multiplier for Magnum hits. This setting affects vehicles only, not NPC Arcade push.

settings.name: vehicleMulShotgun
settings.label: Vehicle Bullet Shotgun multiplier
settings.description: Vehicle impulse multiplier for Shotgun hits. This setting affects vehicles only, not NPC Arcade push.

settings.name: vehicleMulSniper
settings.label: Vehicle Bullet Sniper multiplier
settings.description: Vehicle impulse multiplier for Sniper hits. This setting affects vehicles only, not NPC Arcade push.

settings.name: vehicleOccupantShieldTime
settings.label: Seat protection time (s)
settings.description: How long after a vehicle hit SPLAT should ignore extra ragdoll/impulse layers on current occupants. Does not disable the car impulse.

settings.name: vehicleMulSMG
settings.label: Vehicle Bullet SMG multiplier
settings.description: Vehicle impulse multiplier for SMG hits. This setting affects vehicles only, not NPC Arcade push.

settings.name: vehicleMulAR
settings.label: Vehicle Bullet AR multiplier
settings.description: Vehicle impulse multiplier for AR hits. This setting affects vehicles only, not NPC Arcade push.

settings.name: vehicleMulLMG
settings.label: Vehicle Bullet LMG multiplier
settings.description: Vehicle impulse multiplier for LMG hits. This setting affects vehicles only, not NPC Arcade push.

settings.name: vehicleMulUnknownBullet
settings.label: Vehicle Bullet Unknown bullet multiplier
settings.description: Multiplier used only when a bullet hit does not resolve to Handgun/Magnum/Shotgun/etc. This setting affects vehicles only, not NPC Arcade push.

settings.name: vehicleExitShieldEnabled
settings.label: Experimental: protect vehicle exit animation
settings.description: ON = during enter/exit/pull-out/door transitions, SPLAT waits so the game can finish its seat teleport/mount cleanup before ragdoll impulses resume.

settings.name: vehicleExitShieldTime
settings.label: Exit protection time (s)
settings.description: Small immunity-style window for car door / pull-out / exit animation transitions. Raise if bodies still teleport during exit deaths.

settings.name: vehicleImpulsePlayerOnly
settings.label: Player only
settings.description: ON = only the player can launch vehicles. OFF = NPC hits can also move vehicles.

settings.name: vehicleImpulseCooldown
settings.label: Hit cooldown (s)
settings.description: Per-vehicle cooldown. 0 = every valid hit can push the car.

settings.name: vehicleImpulseMassCompensation
settings.label: Mass compensation
settings.description: Scale impulse by vehicle mass so heavy vehicles still move.

settings.name: vehicleImpulseReferenceMass
settings.label: Reference mass
settings.description: Mass compensation baseline. 1500 is a normal car-ish value.

settings.name: vehicleImpulseMinMassScale
settings.label: Minimum mass scale
settings.description: Lowest mass scale allowed.

settings.name: vehicleImpulseMaxMassScale
settings.label: Maximum mass scale
settings.description: Highest mass scale allowed. Raise this if heavy vehicles barely move.

settings.name: vehicleImpulseClampEnabled
settings.label: Safety cap final impulse
settings.description: Caps final vehicle impulse so very high test values do not instantly stream/teleport cars away. Turn off for extreme launch testing.

settings.name: vehicleImpulseMaxHorizontal
settings.label: Max final horizontal impulse
settings.description: Safety cap for forward/side vehicle shove after mass scaling and weapon multipliers. Top is 16900 for stronger grenade testing while still limiting car teleport/streaming.

settings.name: vehicleImpulseMaxLift
settings.label: Max final vertical lift
settings.description: Safety cap for final upward/downward vehicle impulse after mass scaling and weapon multipliers. Top is 16900 for stronger grenade lift testing.

settings.name: vehicleUseArcadeWeaponFilters
settings.label: Use Arcade weapon allow-list
settings.description: ON = bullet/melee vehicle pushes must also be allowed by the active Arcade weapon group toggles.

settings.name: vehicleUseArcadeWeaponMultipliers
settings.label: Use Arcade weapon multipliers
settings.description: ON = vehicle weapon multipliers are multiplied by the active Arcade weapon multipliers.

settings.name: vehicleBulletStrength
settings.label: Bullet vehicle force
settings.description: Base horizontal force for bullet-driven vehicle pushes. Practical tuning range is 0 to 8000; weapon multipliers stay separate.

settings.name: vehicleBulletLift
settings.label: Bullet vehicle Up
settings.description: Positive upward force for bullet vehicle pushes.

settings.name: vehicleBulletDown
settings.label: Bullet vehicle Down
settings.description: Positive downward vehicle force. Runtime subtracts this from Bullet vehicle Up.

settings.name: vehicleBulletRadius
settings.label: Bullet vehicle impulse radius
settings.description: PhysicalImpulseEvent radius for bullet vehicle pushes.

settings.name: vehicleAllowHandgun
settings.label: Vehicle Handgun
settings.description: Allow Handgun hits to push vehicles.

settings.name: vehicleAllowMagnum
settings.label: Vehicle Magnum
settings.description: Allow Magnum hits to push vehicles.

settings.name: vehicleAllowShotgun
settings.label: Vehicle Shotgun
settings.description: Allow Shotgun hits to push vehicles.

settings.name: vehicleAllowSniper
settings.label: Vehicle Sniper
settings.description: Allow Sniper hits to push vehicles.

settings.name: vehicleAllowSMG
settings.label: Vehicle SMG
settings.description: Allow SMG hits to push vehicles.

settings.name: vehicleAllowAR
settings.label: Vehicle AR
settings.description: Allow AR hits to push vehicles.

settings.name: vehicleAllowLMG
settings.label: Vehicle LMG
settings.description: Allow LMG hits to push vehicles.

settings.name: vehicleAllowUnknownBullet
settings.label: Vehicle Unknown bullet fallback
settings.description: Allow bullet vehicle hits even when REDscript does not expose the exact weapon record. Helps when bullets do nothing on cars.

settings.name: v141
settings.label: Show Vehicle Bullet Push
settings.description: Shows bullet-force controls that move cars and motorcycles.

settings.name: v141
settings.label: Show Advanced Vehicle Bullet Push
settings.description: Shows safety, filtering, mass compensation, cooldown, and advanced vehicle bullet controls.

settings.name: v141
settings.label: Show Vehicle Bullet Weapon Multipliers
settings.description: Shows per-weapon multipliers used when bullets push vehicles.

settings.name: v141
settings.label: Show Vehicle Melee Push
settings.description: Shows melee-force controls that move vehicles.

settings.name: vehicleMeleeEnabled
settings.label: Melee pushes vehicles
settings.description: Blunt, blade, fists, and Gorilla Arms can push vehicles.

settings.name: vehicleMeleeStrength
settings.label: Melee vehicle force
settings.description: Base horizontal force for melee vehicle pushes. Practical tuning range is 0 to 8000; melee/Gorilla multipliers stay separate.

settings.name: vehicleMeleeLift
settings.label: Melee vehicle Up
settings.description: Positive upward force for melee vehicle pushes.

settings.name: vehicleMeleeDown
settings.label: Melee vehicle Down
settings.description: Positive downward vehicle force. Runtime subtracts this from Melee vehicle Up.

settings.name: vehicleMeleeRadius
settings.label: Melee vehicle impulse radius
settings.description: PhysicalImpulseEvent radius for melee vehicle pushes.

settings.name: vehicleAllowBlunt
settings.label: Vehicle Blunt
settings.description: Allow Blunt hits to push vehicles.

settings.name: vehicleMulBlunt
settings.label: Vehicle Blunt multiplier
settings.description: Vehicle impulse multiplier for Blunt hits.

settings.name: vehicleAllowBlade
settings.label: Vehicle Blade
settings.description: Allow Blade hits to push vehicles.

settings.name: vehicleMulBlade
settings.label: Vehicle Blade multiplier
settings.description: Vehicle impulse multiplier for Blade hits.

settings.name: vehicleAllowGorilla
settings.label: Vehicle Gorilla
settings.description: Allow Gorilla hits to push vehicles.

settings.name: vehicleMulGorilla
settings.label: Vehicle Gorilla multiplier
settings.description: Vehicle impulse multiplier for Gorilla hits.

settings.name: realismCustom_arcade_vanillaImpulseControl
settings.label: Show Vanilla Impulse Control
settings.description: Shows the optional game-default impulse allow list for this mode.

settings.name: vanillaImpulsesEnabled

settings.description: Allow vanilla impulses for Blunt.
